metrics.name: Clarity
metrics.construct: Whether every required behaviour is stated so that only one reasonable reading exists, and the statement is easy to understand for a student at the target level
metrics.direction: met is better than partially_met, which is better than not_met
metrics.status_mapping: always not_applicable: the skeleton makes no judgement

validation.method: Gwet's AC1 between the judge's and the Tier 3 expert's derived verdicts on a held-out validation set

metrics.limitations: an LLM judge is an uncalibrated instrument until its agreement with the Tier 3 expert ratings is measured; the checklist items, the critical items and the roll-up rule are not fixed yet
